title: C4OS Grill Question 033 - File Icons Scope

questions.label: Which file icons should the IDE plugin support first?
questions.help: Recommended: common code, config, markdown/document, image, archive, and folder icons. This gives useful coverage without trying to mirror a full IDE icon theme.
options: Common code, config, markdown/document, image, archive, and folder icons
Full VS Code-like file icon theme
Only generic file and folder icons

questions.label: Should hidden files remain visible in the IDE File Explorer?
questions.help: Recommended: preserve MVP behavior: hidden files visible except `.git` unless later narrowed.

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify specific extensions, folder icons, binary file handling, symlinks, or whether file icons should be themeable in v1.
